title: Siamese network with change awareness for surface defect segmentation in complex backgrounds (CADNet)
mechanism: Formulate defect segmentation as change detection against a defect-free reference with a Siamese transformer encoder and a class-balanced contrastive loss; the distance map is skip-connected to the decoder.
adaptation: For E1: reference = defect-free pool cell retrieved by source / mono-multi / full-half-cut, or the median of other cells of the same module (E1 has module ids); feed feature distance map as extra decoder input so module-wide context cancels and cell-specific cracks remain.
evidence: R: beats semantic segmentation baselines on a synthetic LCD set and two public sets, also in semi-supervised settings (numbers not read).
min_experiment: Arm: PF + distance map to retrieved reference; baseline: PF; metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and half-cut false alarms; kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03.
prior_overlap: none: reference-based inputs never tried; D39 covers normal-reference attention (NDP-Net) from the anomaly side.
